title: Process-Based Lagrange Multipliers for Nonconvex Set-Valued Optimization
summary: We develop a Lagrange multiplier theory for nonconvex set-valued optimization problems under Lipschitz-type regularity conditions. Instead of classical continuous linear functionals, we introduce closed convex processes -- set-valued mappings whose graphs are closed convex cones -- as generalized Lagrange multipliers. This geometric framework extends separation principles beyond convexity and differentiability.
